title: Provider io.quarkus.runtime.configuration.TemporaryConfigSourceProvider not found

labels.name: pinned
labels.description: Issue will never be marked as stale

body:
**Describe the bug**
I've added a custom ConfigSourceProvider and as per documentation I've created the related service file. 

When running in JVM mode everything works as expected but when compiling as native image, then the application throws the following exception:
